title: Weekly Part 21 source synchronization
detail: Run run_weekly_source_sync. Import changed supplier workbooks, query connected ERP and supplier connectors, evaluate audit readiness and Part 21 policy coverage, generate the readiness report draft, report pending approvals and unconfigured connectors, and never file reports or promote authoritative graph entities without human approval.
deploymentPrerequisite: Project must be deployed before ScheduleTask can be created.
humanGates: Approve report filing or external notification
